# Golden cases for internal/istree, produced by reference/harness/istree/gen.sh.
# Format: name build data options...
#   build: c = pristine C reference (reference/build.sh release),
#          p = C with reference/patches/istree/fpgrowth-p-order.patch (B2 fixed)
#   data:  file under testdata/data (-R paths are relative to it, too)
# Rules are printed with -v ' %17a %17b %17h %17e', item sets with
# -v ' %17a %17e'. Not used here because the port deliberately differs:
# -S with rules (B8), head-only appearances (B3), -eb (B1), -p with the
# pristine build (B2), and the measures with fixed ruleval bugs (v z y t i
# g f h m s, rules-eval.md B4-B10).

# association rules
t1-r-s20-c50        c t1.tab -tr -s20 -c50
t1-r-s30-c50-o      c t1.tab -tr -s30 -c50 -o
t1-r-m2-n3          c t1.tab -tr -s10 -c40 -m2 -n3
t1-r-el-d110        c t1.tab -tr -s20 -c30 -el -d110
t1-r-app            c t1.tab -tr -s20 -c50 -R t1.app
t1-r-q-1            c t1.tab -tr -s20 -c50 -q-1
t1-r-q0             c t1.tab -tr -s20 -c50 -q0
t3-r-w              c t3.tab -tr -w -s20 -c50 -el -d0
r1-r-default        c r1.tab -tr -s10 -c60
r1-r-ec-ed          c r1.tab -tr -s10 -c30 -ed -d10
r1-r-en-i           c r1.tab -tr -s10 -c30 -en -d2 -i
r1-r-ep             c r1.tab -tr -s10 -c30 -ep -d20
r2-r-ek             c r2.tab -tr -s15 -c50 -ek -d60
r2-r-ew-q2          c r2.tab -tr -s15 -c50 -ew -d20 -q-2
r2-r-ej-o           c r2.tab -tr -s20 -c40 -ej -d10 -o
r2-r-app            c r2.tab -tr -s15 -c50 -R r2.app -eq -d10
r3-r-w-el           c r3.tab -tr -w -s10 -c50 -el -d120
r3-r-w-ea-i         c r3.tab -tr -w -s15 -c60 -ea -d20 -i
r4-r-eu             c r4.tab -tr -s8 -c50 -eu -d150
r4-r-ec-o-n3        c r4.tab -tr -s10 -c70 -ec -d0 -o -n3

# item sets evaluated with a rule measure
t1-s-el-m0          c t1.tab -ts -s20 -el -d0 -m0
t1-s-el-aa          c t1.tab -ts -s10 -el -d110 -aa
t1-c-el             c t1.tab -tc -s10 -el -d110
t1-m-el             c t1.tab -tm -s10 -el -d100
t1-g-el             c t1.tab -tg -s10 -el -d80 -m0
t3-s-w-en           c t3.tab -ts -w -s10 -en -d1 -an
r1-s-el-am          c r1.tab -ts -s10 -el -d90 -am
r1-s-ep-i           c r1.tab -ts -s10 -ep -d50 -i
r1-c-en-an          c r1.tab -tc -s10 -en -d2 -an -q1
r2-s-ec-aa          c r2.tab -ts -s15 -ec -d60 -aa
r2-m-el-n3          c r2.tab -tm -s10 -el -d90 -n3
r2-g-ed-m0          c r2.tab -tg -s15 -ed -d5 -m0
r3-s-w-ej-aa        c r3.tab -ts -w -s10 -ej -d10 -aa
r3-c-w-ek           c r3.tab -tc -w -s10 -ek -d55 -S80
r4-s-eq-am          c r4.tab -ts -s8 -eq -d10 -am -q-2
r4-c-el-ax          c r4.tab -tc -s8 -el -d120
r4-g-ea-an          c r4.tab -tg -s8 -ea -d10 -an

# evaluation pruning (-p) with the corrected call order (B2)
t1-s-el-p0          p t1.tab -ts -s10 -el -d110 -p0
t1-m-el-p0          p t1.tab -tm -s10 -el -d110 -p0
t1-c-en-p1          p t1.tab -tc -s10 -en -d10 -p1
t1-g-el-p0          p t1.tab -tg -s10 -el -d110 -p0
r1-c-el-p0          p r1.tab -tc -s10 -el -d110 -p0
r1-m-el-p-1         p r1.tab -tm -s10 -el -d105 -p-1
r2-s-el-p2          p r2.tab -ts -s15 -el -d105 -p2 -aa
r2-c-ec-p-2         p r2.tab -tc -s15 -ec -d60 -p-2 -am
r3-g-w-el-p2        p r3.tab -tg -w -s10 -el -d110 -p2
r4-m-ek-p0          p r4.tab -tm -s8 -ek -d55 -p0 -an
r4-s-en-p-3         p r4.tab -ts -s8 -en -d1 -p-3
